final: WITH step2 AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(account_avg) AS avg_account_transaction_amount FROM (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3, AVG(t.amount) AS account_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) GROUP BY d.A3), averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_account_transaction_amount) AS overall_region_average FROM step2), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_account_transaction_amount) AS overall_step2_average FROM step2) SELECT s.region, s.avg_account_transaction_amount, s.avg_account_transaction_amount - a.overall_region_average AS difference_from_region_average, s.avg_account_transaction_amount / o.overall_step2_average AS ratio_to_overall_average FROM step2 AS s CROSS JOIN averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_account_transaction_amount > a.overall_region_average
